rule: A determination fixes an identity or removes an obligation that names nothing. It never invents a form, a fee, a waiver, a service recipient, a filing destination or an eligibility rule, and it never satisfies one identity by binding the binary of another.

determinations.determination: DC-33 is the District Court motion-and-affidavit packet, and its official instructions require the participant to bring an Order for Expungement or Sealing of Record to the hearing. Neither DC-33 nor the statewide Forms library supplies an identified order template, and the record contains no Judiciary or clerk confirmation that a self-composed order is accepted. Keep the order source unresolved rather than retiring it as a phantom.
